capabilities: Define typed up/down, next/prev and custom relationships between notes
Show a breadcrumb trail, Tree view and Matrix view of note hierarchy
Move through note sequences with previous/next navigation
Render a note's neighbourhood as Mermaid or Markmap diagrams
Export a note's hierarchy to an Obsidian Canvas
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later; version 4.14.2 is the last release for 1.12. Detailed documentation lives on a separate docs site, and a pre-configured demo vault is offered for trying the plugin.
intentEvidence: Where Obsidian's own graph only shows that two notes link, Breadcrumbs shows how they relate
problem: Obsidian's links and graph only show that two notes are connected, not what kind of relationship they have or where they sit in a hierarchy.
summary: Typed-link hierarchy plugin that builds a directed graph of note relationships and shows it as breadcrumb trails, tree and matrix views.
